author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
translation:
Having known (realised) this, the Yogi indeed passeth all that meritorious reward which is declared for the Vedas, sacrifices, austerities and charitable gifts and lie also attains to the highest and foremost place (Heaven). (28.)
V. This: the nature and meaning of Adhyatma, etc., the omnipotence of the glorious Lord, the description of the path: or this may refer to the realisation of Brahman and the two paths.
